title: Stop Saying "I'm Surprised": 3 Better Words #shorts
description:
Another word for surprised? When something comes out of nowhere, you're not just surprised. Here are 3 better ways to say it:
• Caught off guard: surprised because you weren't ready
• Taken aback: surprised and a little shocked
• Blindsided: hit by something you never expected

Ever had a day like this?
